name: sem
description: Shows Git changes as entity-level diffs of functions, classes, and methods, with impact analysis, entity history, and an MCP server, for developers and coding agents reviewing code.

skills.name: Entity-Level Diff
skills.description: Diffs working changes, commits, or ranges by function, class, and method instead of lines, with JSON and Markdown output.

skills.name: Impact Analysis
skills.description: Lists the dependencies, dependents, and tests affected by changing a given entity.

skills.name: Entity History and Blame
skills.description: Traces an entity's change history, per-entity blame, hotspots, and co-change pairs across the repo.

skills.name: Entity Search
skills.description: Finds functions, classes, and methods by name with their callers, references, and surrounding context.
